# Resilient_Satellite_Constellations

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A distributed network of satellites designed to maintain operational capability and data flow even when individual nodes are degraded or destroyed. Provides a real-world testbed for TCC's topology-aware routing and iNEST's in-network processing under dynamic, failure-prone conditions.
